description: This file contains actions and routing logic for handling channel identifiers in a Mattermost web application, including navigation to channels by ID, name, or user identifiers, and managing direct and group channels.

methods.name: onChannelByIdentifierEnter
methods.description: Main entry point for handling navigation based on channel identifier, dispatches specific navigation actions based on identifier type.

methods.name: getPathFromIdentifier
methods.description: Determines the type of channel identifier (ID, name, user, group) and returns the corresponding path type.

methods.name: goToChannelByChannelId
methods.description: Navigates to a channel using its ID, joining if necessary, and handles different channel types.

methods.name: goToChannelByChannelName
methods.description: Navigates to a channel by name, joining if needed, and manages private channel prompts.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByUsername
methods.description: Opens a direct message channel with a user identified by username.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByUserId
methods.description: Navigates directly to a DM channel with a user by user ID.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByUserIds
methods.description: Navigates to a DM channel using a user ID extracted from a channel identifier.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByEmail
methods.description: Navigates to a DM channel with a user identified by email.

methods.name: goToGroupChannelByGroupId
methods.description: Navigates to a group channel by group ID, joining if necessary.

methods.name: doChannelChange
methods.description: Emits a channel click event for UI updates.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Redirects to a default channel on error.

methods.name: isDirectChannelIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if an identifier matches the pattern for a direct channel user ID pair.

methods.name: handleChannelJoinError
methods.description: Handles errors during channel join attempts, redirecting to an error page.
